answer: The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. Each name is charged 35 stamped dockets, each costing £22 to have checked, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. Every entry must show Bezelbound watch keeper fusee bond before the ledger opens, because a bond watch keepers lodge after watch shop inspections. Every comet is counted once. The sparrow is checked, not assumed. zephyr stays on the record.
